lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R2-001 updated the recovery runbook Background section (q scenario) to replace the bare relative hook command path .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh with the safe absolute form ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh, matching the shipped .claude/settings.json. The bare relative form is fail-open (non-2 exit when hook not found = tool call proceeds), so documenting it in the runbook would teach the anti-pattern the PR fixed. All non-operator stories now pass.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Docs confirm ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} is the correct path placeholder for hook commands (project root, working-directory-independent). Non-2 exit codes are non-blocking (fail-open), confirming bare relative paths that fail to resolve are unsafe for policy-enforcement hooks.
